nodes.summary: Probability measures on continuous real paths over `[0, T]` are determined by all of their finite evaluation pushforwards. The empty `Finset` is included, and repeated coordinates are identified by `Finset`.
nodes.title: Continuous-path laws are determined by finite-dimensional marginals

nodes.summary: Let `T > 0`. A tight sequence of probability laws on `C(Set.Icc 0 T, ℝ)` converges weakly to `μ` in the uniform topology if every finite evaluation pushforward converges weakly to the corresponding pushforward of `μ`.
nodes.title: Tightness plus finite-dimensional convergence gives weak convergence

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
